bio.text: Brian Jones was elected in 2022 to represent California's 40th Senate District; he was elected to the 38th Senate District in 2018.

Earlier, he served on the Santee City Council from 2002 to 2010 and again from 2017 to 2018, and in the Assembly, representing the 77th District from 2010 to 2012 and the 71st District from 2012 to 2016.

According to his Senate biography, he moved to Santee in San Diego County at age ten, graduated from Grossmont College and earned a bachelor's degree in business administration at San Diego State University. He worked in commercial real estate and lives in Santee.
